blocks.html: Manila, Philippines – RLC Residences, the residential arm of property giant Robinsons Land Corporation, recently unveiled the newest tower of Amisa Private Residences – its resort-inspired residential development in Cebu.

The leisure condominium development recorded impressive take-up for its first three towers, attracting strong market demand for its stunning features and ideal location. Sitting elegantly on the northern tip of Punta Engaño Peninsula, AmiSa is located in the same vicinity to the world-renowned Dusit Thani Mactan Resort.

Launched in February 2022, the 16-storey tower features a total of over 170 studio, onebedroom, and two-bedroom flat-type units. Positioned as an ideal vacation home investment, AmiSa Private Residences provides an elevated home life with its unobstructed view of the sea from the residents’ own units and through the Sky Lounge located at the topmost floor of Tower D. Residents can look forward to a 360 resort-like experience made possible by a well-trained property management group, and the wide range of leisure amenities.

AmiSa Private Residences also provide unit owners with exclusive privileges to Dusit Thani Mactan Resort. Complementing the ultimate vacation lifestyle experience, Dusit Thani Mactan Resort extends its five-star hotel and resort services to AmiSa residents in the form of beach access, on-call shuttle services, and its modern amenities and facilities.

Apart from its spacious living spaces, units at the new tower are equipped with smart home features, as well as unique home upgrades, such as glass balcony railings, increased window sizes, and work-from-home spaces, among others. “We are proud to finally introduce this new residential development in Cebu featuring our improved home offerings, in line with our commitment to continuously raise the standards of living. We hope that through this, along with our upcoming projects, we can be our customer’s reliable partner in their quest to find the home that they dream of,” shares John Richard Sotelo, SVP – Business Unit General Manager of RLC Residences.

Guided by its brand promise of building beautiful, well-designed homes, RLC Residences is raising the standards of living by continuously innovating its residential offerings to cater to the changing needs of modern Filipinos.
